_comment_intro: Main configuration file. Standard JSON doesn't support comments, so we use _comment fields as notes.
_comment_input_mode: Choose your primary input method. Options: 'typing', 'audio_loopback', 'dual_audio', OR 'websocket_audio'.
_comment_output_mode: Choose your rendering destination. Options: 'opencv' (local window), 'virtual_cam' (OBS Camera for Zoom), OR 'electron' (Hologram UI).
_comment_data_source: Choose where to load ASL animations from. Options: 'local' (assets/jsons/) OR 'aws' (DynamoDB).
_comment_display: Settings for rendering the Avatar canvas.
_comment_audio: Audio capture settings. Adjust silence_timeout_sec to change how aggressively speech is chunked into phrases.
_comment_playback: speed_ms defines the time between keyframes (60ms ~ 16.7FPS). transition_frames controls smooth frames injected between distinct signs. interpolation_frames injects smooth auto-completed frames between standard animation frames.
_comment_network: Settings to pass 3D coordinate arrays live to an external rendering engine (like Unity). Set 'enable_websocket' to true to start the server.
_comment_colors: RGB color values for the drawn points. (f=Face, p=Pose, l=Left Hand, r=Right Hand).
